propositions: A new `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since`, `--until`, and `--output json|text` arguments and render metrics from the full registry over the specified date range.
The metrics command must call `rebar.metrics.registry.evaluate()` on every `MetricSpec`, catching exceptions per metric and rendering unavailable metrics with error reasons rather than crashing.

The command must output metrics in JSON format (default) as `{"metrics": {<id>: value_or_unavailable}}` or in text format as one line per metric, with every registered metric id appearing in both formats.

The CLI dispatch must route `metrics` via an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` arm (not a frozenset), and the `individual` frozenset in the help-coverage test must include `"metrics"` so the portability guard counts it.

The `metrics.py` command module must import `rebar.metrics` (the package, triggering `__init__.py` reader registration side-effects) to hydrate `REGISTRY`, and must NOT import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (enforced by source-level scan in tests).
Help text, golden CLI snapshots, and generated CLI reference must be created/regenerated to advertise the `metrics` subcommand in the overview and provide pinned help coverage.
